description: Statistics worked out on our side, for when you can't run code: per-column count, mean, std, quantiles and range ("stats"), a correlation matrix ("correlation"), or the series resampled to at most 500 points ("resample"). Same slice arguments and plan rules as get_data. Decodes only the columns you name (up to 12, numeric; default the first 6).

aggregate.description: resample only: how a bucket is reduced. Default "mean".

columns.description: Numeric field names from describe_dataset. Default: the first 6.

dataset.description: A dataset id from list_datasets: a metrics dataset such as "flow", or a raw one such as "raw:trades".

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: the end of the free preview month.

points.description: resample only: buckets across the range. Default 200.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: the free preview, 2025-05-01 for metrics, 2025-06-01 for raw.

symbol.description: Symbol id from find_symbols. Default perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT.

timestamp.description: Metrics only: 'exchange' uses the exchange-reported timestamp (default), 'true' the arrival time at our servers.

name: summarize
title: Summarize a slice
